response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (14+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, current AI-agent/MCP tooling experience, cloud/containerization exposure (Docker/Kubernetes), multi-language versatility (Java, C#, DLang), and a solid testing/TDD craftsmanship culture — all closely aligned with the role's stack and required skills. Some gaps exist around explicit Nest.js, Vitest, PostgreSQL, and formal auth/security experience, but his breadth, seniority, and adaptability make him a strong candidate worth interviewing.
strengths: 14+ years of full-stack experience across web, mobile, and backend systems with proven seniority
Current hands-on AI-agent/MCP development experience, directly matching a required skill
Strong testing/TDD culture (built own testing libraries/frameworks) and multi-language proficiency (TS, Java, C#, DLang)
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest, the primary framework/testing tools specified
Limited evidence of PostgreSQL experience (mostly MongoDB/MySQL) and no explicit auth/security specialization
Long history of frequent job changes and diverse side-projects may indicate less focus/depth in any single enterprise-scale backend architecture role

key_factors.factor: Deep full-stack TS/Node experience with cloud & containers
